name: devsu-api-tests
description: Newman runner for the Devsu PetStore API challenge collection

scripts.test: newman run petstore-api.postman_collection.json --folder "Ciclo de vida: crear, actualizar y eliminar un usuario" --reporters cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export ../reports/newman-report.html
scripts.test:defect: newman run petstore-api.postman_collection.json --folder "Defecto documentado: PUT /user con id: 0" --reporters cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export ../reports/newman-defect-report.html
